reader.requirement: At --std 85 the compiler must accept FUNCTION COS ( argument-1 ) with exactly one argument, as a numeric function inside an arithmetic expression, and refuse the forms the 1985 function-identifier format and the COS definition exclude: no argument list, an empty '( )' list, two or more arguments, a reference-modifier on the numeric result, and (SR4) the function written where an identifier rather than an arithmetic expression stands.
